title: Admissible test form with prescribed values on a face (steps 5–6)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ and n := m + 1. Let p = (ι, b) be an index pair with ι : Fin n → Fin P strictly increasing and b : Fin P → ℤ. Write e_l := EuclideanSpace.single l 1, Φ_p(y) := b + Σ_j y_j e_{ι(j)} (Lean: WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)), and Q₁ := (0,1)ⁿ = {y ∈ Euclid n : 0 < y_i < 1 for all i}. Let N ⊆ Euclid P be open with Φ_p(y) ∈ N for every y ∈ Q₁. Let g : Euclid n → Euclid n be C^∞ (ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞), smooth but not necessarily analytic), with compact support, tsupport g ⊆ Q₁ and ‖g(y)‖ ≤ 1 for all y (Euclidean norm of Euclid n). Then there is a test m-form γ on Euclid P (γ ∈ TestFormOn univ m) such that: tsupport γ ⊆ N; covectorEuclideanNorm(γ(x)) ≤ 1 for all x; and for every y ∈ Euclid n and every i ∈ Fin n, g(y)_i = (−1)^i · γ(Φ_p y)(fun l => e_{ι(i.succAbove l)}). In words, the i-th component of g(y) is (−1)^i times γ(Φ_p y) evaluated on (e_{ι(0)}, …, e_{ι(m)}) with its i-th vector removed.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (p : (Fin (m + 1) → Fin P) × (Fin P → ℤ)) (N : Set (Euclid P)) (g : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1)), StrictMono p.1 → IsOpen N → (∀ y : Euclid (m + 1), (∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1) → (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) ∈ N) → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} → (∀ y, ‖g y‖ ≤ 1) → ∃ γ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, tsupport (γ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) ⊆ N ∧ (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((γ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x) ≤ 1) ∧ ∀ (y : Euclid (m + 1)) (i : Fin (m + 1)), g y i = (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i : ℕ) * (γ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun k => (p.2 k : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) (fun l => EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 (Fin.succAbove i l)) (1 : ℝ))
